mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling regression over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals a supply shock combined with monetary tightening, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 100.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling regression over 3 years.
